integrity: Ordinary mathematical proof with exhaustive finite testing and diagnostic seeded simulation; this is not independent audit, and possible unindexed equivalent prior results remain an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The distributional limit concerns depth-aligned content-token disagreements after a single uniformly selected interior bit flip of an i.i.d. fair binary word; it does not establish optimal token edit distance, arbitrary source laws, or a higher-alphabet theorem.
title: A mixed uniform limit for single-bit perturbations of bilateral run-pair tokens
